brand.notes: Every visible wordmark carries the period: the running header, the title-block date line and the body use the \ac macro, which sets it in AC pink; the bibliography entries carry a plain period, since a .bib howpublished field cannot colour it (same convention as Paying for Strangers).

diagrams.notes: Inspected at crop resolution. A single vertical spine: pink run stages, purple Claude stages, two outlined outputs. The two propose/probe branches are symmetric peers with equal node sizes; every arrow ends on a node border, nothing crosses, and the dashed library-to-base loop runs in its own channel on the right with its label beside it. Sans labels are legible at print size. The column-width figure leaves margin either side of the spine, which reads as the spine being the subject rather than as stranded space.

figures.notes: Inspected at crop resolution. Six equal frames in three columns with equal gutters and baselines; each column is one comparison, chosen pieces ticked. Labels read at print size. The evidence dominates: the folded jelly rim, the empty dead-state snake board reading score 0 · best 0, and the waiting snake are visible without zooming. The blank trails frame is deliberate evidence, explained in the caption. Caption sits directly beneath at full text width.

tables.notes: Full-width booktabs table; seven columns align, every row fits on one line, drawn ticks and crosses are legible, chosen arms set in bold, costs right-aligned.

pageReview.notes: Inspected all four page rasters at full resolution and the contact sheet. Page 1 title block and abstract; page 2 two balanced columns with the round diagram top-right; page 3 the rounds table and frames figure share the top as full-width floats near the text that cites them, two columns below; page 4 balanced short columns (\balance) ending with references and the source bundle. No overfull lines, undefined references or missing glyphs in the log.
